name: H correct, named arrow passed
H arrow with a braces body
code:
function transform(value, fn) { return fn(value); }
console.log(transform(5, n => { return n * 2; }));

name: H function expression passed, not an arrow
code:
function transform(value, fn) { return fn(value); }
console.log(transform(5, function (n) { return n + 1; }));

console.log(transform(2, n => n + 1));
